nodes.title: CRUN • Crun Vidu Template Video Generation API

widgets_values:
ADVANCED API PREPARATION ONLY — NO FINISHED MEDIA ADAPTER

CRUN NEXT — NATIVE MEDIA WORKFLOW

START: Action=prepare, optional cap=0, Take=0. No upload, provider request or generation occurs in Prepare.
Choose local media in the connected Load nodes. Native inputs keep their documented roles; URL/JSON fallbacks remain Advanced.
Estimate uploads references and displays the current quote. Generate submits once, waits and returns native media directly to Preview/Save.
The same settings and Take resume/reuse their existing task. Increase Take only to intentionally request a new paid generation.
After a timeout, keep the task ID and resume it; do not create a replacement automatically.
The optional positive cap stays under Advanced; 0 disables it. Actual credits and remaining balance are separate from estimates.
Enter your API key only in Settings > CRUN Next, never in this graph.

Option: Crun Vidu Template Video Generation API
Model: vidu/template
Documentation: https://docs.crun.ai/templates/vidu-template

This recipe is an Advanced API draft, not a complete creative integration. LLM/3D or a dedicated unsupported protocol may require raw structured inputs. Keep Prepare; a listed API is not proof of live execution.

The provider has not established this Effect's output media format. It deliberately has no IMAGE/VIDEO preview contract until that result type is verified.
